verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's incremental materialized views automatically trigger computation when new data (events/inserts) arrive, shifting cost from query time to insert time — a limited form of 'rule triggers on event' behavior, but this is scoped to SQL transformation, not a general action/automation rules engine (e.g. alerts, webhooks, external actions). Missing for 10: evidence of a broader rule/alerting/action framework, triggers tied to arbitrary conditions beyond inserts, or integration with external action systems (notifications, workflows).
